title: Geo + Instance Launch: reservation plans, docs, and GTM runbook
creator: Arjun Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket coordinates the product launch activities for the next Dedicated Capacity push: two new regions (eu-west-3, ap-southeast-2), two new instance families (rdu-8x, rdu-16x), and a new 12-month reservation plan with quarterly billing. Scope includes product readiness, release notes, console UX messaging, pricing documentation, partner comms, and post-launch monitoring dashboards.

Objectives:
- Ensure API and Console surface reflect region/instance availability and reservation SKUs.
- Produce final release notes and changelog entries that are consumption-friendly for customers and partners.
- Align Sales, Solutions, Support, and Legal for contract/reservation terms and FAQs.
- Validate metrics and alerts (SLO changes, capacity oversubscription, billing spikes).

Stakeholders:
- PM Owner: Arjun Patel (creator)
- Launch Lead / Assignee: Maya Chen
- Engineering Owners: SRE (ENG-8123), Serving Runtime (ENG-8250)
- Design: Lena Ortiz (console banners & flow)
- Sales Ops: Marco Rivera (reservation SKUs)
- Legal & Compliance: Priya Nair (region data residency review)
- Support & Success: Kofi Mensah (runbook & escalation path)

Deliverables / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Product: Regions and instance types available in console and API (test plan green).
2) Billing: Reservation plan appears in billing UI, invoice preview validated by Finance.
3) Docs: Release notes, pricing page update, and FAQ published to docs.redwood.com.
4) GTM: Sales playbook, partner one-pager, launch email sequence, dedicated webinars scheduled.
5) Monitoring: Dashboard tile (reservations utilization), and alert runbook created in PagerDuty.

Release Notes Coordination Tasks (owner in parens):
- Draft high-level product notes for public release (Maya).
- Technical changelog for devs: API responses, new region headers, error codes (ENG-8250).
- Breaking/compatibility callouts: none anticipated; include fallback guidance if region unavailable (SRE).
- Legal-approved pricing language and restrictions (Priya).
- Localization plan for EU/ANZ markets (i18n lead).

GTM Checklist (cross-functional):
- Sales enablement: SKU list, margin guidance, objection handling (Sales Ops).
- Solutions templates: example terraform + API snippets for region pinning and reservation purchase (Solutions Eng).
- Marketing: launch blog draft, customer announcement cadence, webinar registration page (Marketing PM).
- Support: updated troubleshooting KB, escalation matrix, replacement region mapping (Support).
- Partner Ops: marketplace SKU submission for cloud marketplace listings.

Launch Timeline (high level):
- 2026-02-20 (created): kickoff, scope agreed.
- 2026-02-28: API & infra readiness beta build (ENG) - COMPLETED
- 2026-03-05: Internal docs & draft release notes circulated - IN REVIEW
- 2026-03-10: Legal signoff on reservation terms - COMPLETED
- 2026-03-17: Design finalizes console flows and banners - IN PROGRESS
- 2026-03-24: Sales enablement pack complete - BLOCKED BY pricing confirmation
- 2026-04-01: Soft-launch to selected tenants (canary)
- 2026-04-08: Full public launch and marketing announcement

Progress Updates / Recent Activity:
- 2026-02-28: ENG delivered beta with region flags behind feature toggles. Integration tests passing in staging. (Arjun)
- 2026-03-03: Draft release notes posted to internal Google Drive: https://drive.example.com/dedicated-launch-draft (Maya)
- 2026-03-05: Finance requested explicit invoice examples for reservation amortization; assigned to Marco.
- 2026-03-07: SRE added capacity guardrail to prevent oversubscription during canary.
- 2026-03-10: Legal approved reservation T&Cs for EU/ANZ; security review required for on-prem telemetry; added to dependencies.

Risks & Mitigations:
- Risk: Late billing integration could delay public launch. Mitigation: soft-launch with manual billing reconciliation for first week; prioritize Finance PR.
- Risk: Regional data residency questions from enterprise customers. Mitigation: explicit region residency FAQ + Legal sign-off; include contact for account teams.
- Risk: Unexpected QoS regression on smaller instances. Mitigation: conservative autoscaler thresholds, throttle burst quotas for new SKUs.

Open Decisions:
- Final naming for reservation SKU (monthly-vs-quarterly) pending Finance meeting on 2026-03-12.
- Whether to offer one-time migration credits for early customers (Sales to propose).

Next Steps (owner / due):
- Maya: finalize public release notes and submit to Docs for publication (due 2026-03-14).
- Marco: provide invoice preview artifacts for Finance (due 2026-03-12).
- Lena: deliver console banner and in-flow copy (due 2026-03-17).
- ENG: flip region feature flag in a controlled canary for 10 customers (target 2026-04-01).
